statement.p: Calculate the length of the path over the given interval. (\sin \theta - \theta \cos \theta, \cos \theta + \theta \sin \theta), \, 0 \le \theta \le 3

static.solution: x = \sin \theta - \theta \cos \theta and y = \cos \theta + \theta \sin \theta. Hence, x' = \cos \theta - \left( \cos \theta - \theta \sin \theta \right) = \theta \sin \theta and y' = - \sin \theta + \sin \theta + \theta \cos \theta = \theta \cos \theta. Using the formula for the arc length we obtain: S = \int ^{3} _0 \sqrt{x'(\theta)^2 + y'(\theta)^2} \, dt = \int ^{3} _0 \sqrt{ \left( \theta \sin \theta \right) ^2 + \left( \theta \cos \theta \right)^2 } \, d \theta = \int ^{3} _0 \sqrt{ \theta^2 \left( \sin^2 \theta + \cos^2 \theta \right) } \, d \theta = \int ^{3} _0 \theta \, d \theta = \frac{\theta^2}{2} \mid ^{3} _0 = \frac{9}{2} = 4.5
